operation: backup, program and verify minimal Zephyr bringup firmware
authorization: 用户要求按顺序执行基础固件工作，已回复接好供电/J-Link/NRST/串口；已告知先备份再烧录，启动选项不变
can: disconnected; no CAN driver or injection timer in this firmware
limits: No option-byte/protection changes, no mass erase, no CAN TX or injection. Program only artifact-covered Flash pages, verifybin, reset and run. Stop on failed backup/identity/verification
recovery: Keep full prior Flash backup and OPTR readout; restore prior firmware if new image fails and connection remains usable
serial: ttyUSB0 CH340 VID1A86 PID7523 location1-1.1; 115200 8N1, bounded receive only; no UART TX; no wired DTR/RTS controls
